# Systemia Website Audit commercial intent cluster

Public ID: audit-center-website-audit-machine-v1
Problem: A small business or contractor needs evidence-backed website triage across performance, technical SEO, local SEO and trust/conversion before spending money fixing the wrong things.
Pricing: Free preview. Quick Win Audit $49 one-time and machine-fulfilled after verified payment; the $49 may be credited toward Complete Audit. Complete Audit $500 one-time. Audit + Patch $1,200 one-time.
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: payment_ready
Human review: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?view=service&public_id=audit-center-website-audit-machine-v1
Capability contract: /chum/capabilities/audit-center-website-audit-machine-v1/

## Brand-blind user language

- why is my website not getting leads
- audit my website
- why is my contractor website not ranking
- check my local SEO
- why is my site slow on mobile
- find conversion problems on my website
- review my website SEO
- tell me what is wrong with my business website
- my website gets traffic but nobody contacts us
- people visit my site but do not contact me
- why is my website not converting
- website traffic but no leads
- visitors are not turning into leads

## Boundary

- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout requires explicit human confirmation where supported.
- Paid state requires authoritative provider verification.
